title: Layout Plan
description: Fifty mechanic tuples, planned as a set before any card is built. Building cards one at a time produces reasonable local choices and a repetitive library, because you never see the set. This file IS the set.

layout.description: Human-readable name, unique across the library

mechanic.description: Rendered as partition:flow:enumerator:emphasis:media:chrome and written to data-mechanic in the build

chrome.description: The surface GROUND: a full colour treatment (ground plus every text role recoloured), not a background swap. A library must use at least 5 named grounds -- a light/dark pair is the most common failure in generated work. Loud grounds (ink, accent-1, accent-2) must never sit on adjacent cards.

claims.description: Claim ids this card is assembled from. Written to data-claim in the build so the veracity check is a lookup.

rows.description: Planned content rows. Cross-checked against a 'few-rows' license.

intent.description: fill = distribute rows across the card (correct for ~40 of 50). breathe = fixed rhythm from the top, slack collects at the bottom as one block.

license.description: REQUIRED when intent is 'breathe'. The license is recorded, not remembered -- the auditor cross-checks it, which is what stops it decaying into marking everything 'breathe'.

distribution_check.description: Filled in by uniq.py. Targets per 50 cards: media 14-20, figure-emphasis 8-12, >=8 partitions used, <=9 cards per partition, mean pairwise distance >= 2.6, >=5 surface grounds. Ground mix: paper 20-26, panel 6-9, ink 6-9, accent-1 4-6, accent-2 2-4, grey 3-5.
